intent_classes.label: Thanks
intent_classes.description: A clearly appreciative turn with no ERP data request.

intent_classes.label: Acknowledgement
intent_classes.description: A short acknowledgement turn that does not request new ERP data.

intent_classes.label: Capability Question
intent_classes.description: A question about what the assistant can help with inside governed ERP scope.

intent_classes.label: Governed KPI Definition
intent_classes.description: A request to explain a governed KPI definition or approved formula basis from the business-definition registry.

intent_classes.label: Governed KPI Value
intent_classes.description: A request to execute an approved governed KPI value from the KPI execution registry for an explicit scope or period.

intent_classes.label: Session Flow
intent_classes.description: A request to continue or advance the current grounded session flow.

intent_classes.label: Low-signal Non-business
intent_classes.description: A very short non-business turn with no clear ERP request.

intent_classes.label: Closure / Signoff
intent_classes.description: A conversational turn that politely ends or pauses the session without requesting ERP data.

intent_classes.label: Route Onward
intent_classes.description: A plausible ERP or business request that should continue through the main system lanes.
